map.理想汽油机（定容加热）热效率 使用指南: Ideal Gasoline Engine (Constant-Volume Heating) Efficiency User Guide
map.输入压缩比 r 与比热比 γ，计算理想汽油机（定容加热）奥托循环热效率 η，用于: Entering the compression ratio r and the specific heat ratio gamma, this computes the thermal efficiency eta of the ideal gasoline engine (constant-volume heating) Otto cycle, for engine cycle comparison and compression ratio effect analysis.
map.η_otto = 1 − 1/r^(γ−1)。 r=10、γ=1.4 → η≈6: eta_otto = 1 - 1/r^(gamma-1). With r=10 and gamma=1.4 -> eta is about 60.2%.
map.输入压缩比 r 与比热比 γ，求奥托循环热效率。: Enter the compression ratio r and the specific heat ratio gamma to find the Otto cycle thermal efficiency.
map.填写「比热比 γ」。: Enter the specific heat ratio gamma.
map.汽油机理想定容加热循环效率 η=1−1/r^(γ−1)。: The ideal gasoline engine (constant-volume heating) Otto cycle efficiency is eta = 1 - 1/r^(gamma-1).
map.压缩比对效率的影响。: Effect of compression ratio on efficiency.
map.多方指数 n 过程的体积功: Volumetric work of a multi-index n process
map.显热（Q = m·c·ΔT）: Sensible heat (Q = m x c x dT)
map.辐射功率（P = ε·σ·A·T⁴）: Radiated power (P = epsilon x sigma x A x T^4)
map.双层复合壁总热阻与热流: Total thermal resistance and heat flow of a double-layer composite wall
map.r 越大 η 越高，但汽油机受爆震限制（一般≤12）。: The larger r is, the higher the efficiency, but gasoline engines are limited by knock (generally 12 or less).
map.实际汽油机热效率约 30%～38%，远低于理想值。: The actual thermal efficiency of a gasoline engine is about 30%-38%, far below the ideal value.
